actual_origins_definition:
fun {n} [NeZero n] c r =>
  { record //
    ∃ word,
      (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run (ProperArc.arc c r) (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.singletonExecution n)
            word).origin =
        some record }

targets.name: ProperArc.extract_first_registration
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (F : Finset (ZMod n)) (start : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n))
  (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter) (record : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.FusionRecord (ZMod n)),
  start.origin = none →
    (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F start word).origin = some record →
      ∃ pre post U V,
        word = pre ++ RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter.d :: post ∧
          (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F start pre).origin = none ∧
            (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F start pre).placed 0 = some U ∧
              (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F start pre).placed 1 = some V ∧
                U ∪ V = F ∧ record = { left := U, right := V, result := F }

targets.name: ProperArc.sourceOrdered_registration_cut
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (P : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Placement n (Finset (ZMod n))) (c : ZMod n) (r : ℕ)
  (U V : Finset (ZMod n)),
  r < n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.SourceOrdered P →
      P 0 = some U →
        P 1 = some V →
          U ∪ V = ProperArc.arc c r → ∃ t, 1 ≤ t ∧ t < r ∧ U = ProperArc.interval c 0 t ∧ V = ProperArc.interval c t r

targets.name: ProperArc.actual_registered_origin_unique
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r : ℕ) (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)),
  2 ≤ r ∧ r < n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.ReachableExecution (ProperArc.arc c r) s →
      s.origin ≠ none → ∃! i, s.origin = some (ProperArc.originRecord c r (↑i + 1))

targets.name: ProperArc.actual_registered_origin_unique_nat
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r : ℕ) (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)),
  2 ≤ r ∧ r < n →
    RegisteredAbsorptionChains.ReachableExecution (ProperArc.arc c r) s →
      s.origin ≠ none → ∃! t, 1 ≤ t ∧ t < r ∧ s.origin = some (ProperArc.originRecord c r t)

targets.name: ProperArc.actualRegistrationOriginsEquivCuts
targets.signature:
{n : ℕ} →
  [inst : NeZero n] → (c : ZMod n) → (r : ℕ) → 2 ≤ r ∧ r < n → ProperArc.ActualRegistrationOrigins c r ≃ Fin (r - 1)

targets.name: ProperArc.card_actualRegistrationOrigins
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r ∧ r < n → Nat.card (ProperArc.ActualRegistrationOrigins c r) = r - 1

targets.name: ProperArc.run_local_unregistered
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (F : Finset (ZMod n)) (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n (ZMod n)) (j : ZMod n)
  (U V : Finset (ZMod n)),
  s.placed j = some U →
    s.placed (j + 1) = some V →
      s.origin = none →
        U ∪ V ≠ F →
          RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.localLetters j) =
            { placed := ProperArc.localFusion j s.placed, origin := s.origin, chain := s.chain }

targets.name: ProperArc.run_originWord
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] (c : ZMod n) (r t : ℕ),
  r < n →
    1 ≤ t →
      t < r →
        RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run (ProperArc.arc c r) (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.singletonExecution n)
            (ProperArc.originWord c r t) =
          { placed := ProperArc.boundaryPlacement c r, origin := some (ProperArc.originRecord c r t), chain := [] }

targets.name: ProperArc.boundary_clean
targets.signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (c : ZMod n) (r : ℕ),
  (∃ q, ProperArc.boundaryPlacement c r q = some (ProperArc.arc c r)) ∧
    ∀ (q : ZMod n) (B : Finset (ZMod n)),
      ProperArc.boundaryPlacement c r q = some B → B = ProperArc.arc c r ∨ ∃ a, B = {a}
